name: Precomputed Multiple Scattering Table
definition: Multiple scattering corresponds to light that has reached $v_i$, is scattered several times before reaching $P_k$ and is scattered one last time into direction $\hat{o}$.
summary: Precomputed Multiple Scattering Table accelerates volume rendering by storing Monte-Carlo precomputed radiance of high-order scattering events in 4D lookup tables, distinct from geometric or filter-based approximations.
